title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Vehicles Never Collected
content:
A renter who does not collect the vehicle within the supplier's holding time of 2 hours after the scheduled collection is recorded as a no-show and the rate class's no-show charge is withheld. A no-show releases the whole rental, and the remaining days are cancelled with no further charge. A no-show charge and a cancellation charge are never both withheld on the same rental: whichever applies replaces the other. No charge is withheld where the renter could not collect because the supplier had no vehicle, and the supplier notice terms apply instead. Where the prepayment already held is smaller than the charge, the balance is taken from the card on file, and where it is larger the difference is returned. A renter who arrives after the holding time has passed is treated as a fresh walk-up at the counter and not as the holder of this rental.

**The holding time.** The supplier holds the vehicle for 2 hours after the scheduled collection moment. Within that time the rental stands and the renter may still collect. Once it has run out without collection, the rental is recorded as a no-show on the Car Rental Rate Classes, the class's no-show charge is withheld, and the days that remain on the rental fall away with nothing further charged for them.

**Money already held, and money still owed.**

| What the prepayment already held comes to | What follows |
|---|---|
| Less than the no-show charge | The balance is taken from the card on file |
| More than the no-show charge | The difference is returned |

**Where a no-show is not recorded.** Where the renter could not collect because the supplier had no vehicle, no charge is withheld, and the matter falls to the terms on supplier notices rather than to these. A renter who arrives after the holding time has passed stands at the counter as a fresh walk-up, holding nothing under this rental.
